content.title: Which restaurants are open Easter 2026? Chipotle, Starbucks, Chilis, more
content.text: Easter is Sunday, April 5, 2025, a Christian holiday that celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ and many families may be out attending mass, at Easter eggs hunts or visiting family and friends.No plans to make Easter dinner? Some retail and grocery stores close on April 5 this year, and while that's the case for some restaurants and fast-food chains, it's not for all.Want to stop by Starbucks to grab a coffee, drive-thru Dunkin', check if Chili's is open or book a reservation at The Cheesecake Factory? Here's what restaurants are open and closed on Easter 2026.StarbucksStarbucks is open on Easter in most regions; however, Starbucks hours vary by location. To find Starbucks hours at a location near you, use the Starbucks app or head to Starbucks.com.Dunkin'Dunkin' is open on Easter and most holidays, but Dunkin' store hours on Easter vary by location. Customers can check their local Dunkin using the Dunkin' app or the Dunkin store locator.McDonald'sMcDonald's is open on Easter in most regions, but McDonald's Easter hours vary by location. Confirm hours on the McDonald's app or search a McDonald's near you on the McDonald's website.ChipotleChipotle is closed on Easter, a company spokesperson told USA TODAY.Chili'sChili's is open on Easter in most regions; however, Chilis hours on Easter Sunday vary, with many open 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. ET. Check your nearest Chili's location for holiday hours or download the Chili's app for a location near you.Chick-fil-AChick-fil-A is closed on Sundays, per restaurant tradition. Since Easter falls on Sunday, Chick-fil-A is closed on April 5.The Cheesecake FactoryThe Cheesecake Factory is open on Easter, with most locations offering lunch and dinner, though hours vary by location. Check holiday hours on The Cheesecake Factory website or the Cheesecake Factory app for a location near you. Bonus: If you download the app, you get a free slice of cheesecake with any purchase, now through April 30.Wendy'sMost Wendy's open on Easter, but hours vary by location. Check your local Wendy's restaurant for holiday hours.Applebee'sApplebee's is open on Easter, typically operating usual business hours. However, check your local Applebee's location for specific holiday hours. Head to Applebees.com for locations nearby, orBurger KingBurger King is open on Easter in most regions; however, Burger King hours vary by location. Check out Burger King locations on the Burger King website or the Burger King app.Taco BellTaco Bell is open on Easter; however, Taco Bell hours on Easter vary by location. Head to the Taco Bell website for locations and holidays hours, or download the Taco Bell app.SubwaySubway is open on Easter, but hours vary by location and franchise, so check your local Subway for holiday hours. Find a Subway near you at Subway.com or download the Subway app.Jersey Mike'sJersey Mike's is open on Easter, but hours vary by location, with some closing early and others opening later. Since they are a franchise, check your local Jersey Mike's for holiday hours using the Jersey Mike's app or head to JerseyMikes.com.Friendly'sFriendly's is open on Easter; however, Friendly's hours on Easter vary by location. Check your local Friendly's to confirm their holiday hours or use the Friendly's app to find a location near you.IHOPIHOP is open on Easter, though hours vary by location. Head to IHOP for holiday hours, or find an IHOP near you using the IHOP app.White CastleWhite Castle is open on Easter across most regions; however, holiday hours vary by location. Some White Castle restaurants open 24/7, but Easter hours might differ by restaurant. Head to White Castle to find a location near you or download the White Castle app.WawaWawa is open on Easter, though some locations open with reduced or modified hours. Check your local Wawa for store hours or download the Wawa mobile app for locations and hours.QuickChekQuickChek is open on Easter, but hours vary by location. Check your local QuickChek to confirm holiday hours or download the QC mobile app to find a convenience store near you.7-Eleven7-Eleven is open on Easter, with most locations open regular business hours. It's best to check your local store on the 7-Eleven website for specific store hours, as some operate on modified schedules. Download the 7Rewards app to find a store near you.Lori Comstock is a New Jersey-based news reporter covering trending news with USA TODAY Network's Mid-Atlantic Connect Team. She covers health and other news in the Northeast, including New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Washington DC, Maryland, and Virginia.
